title: Apple Watch Series 12 hands-on: What's new?
excerpt: The Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 bring new health sensors, smarter features and a closer look at what's changed.
content_html:
Apple has announced the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, bringing upgraded health sensors, continuous heart-rate sampling and new AI-powered features. CNET's Vanessa Hand Orellana gives a first look at the new S11 chip, readiness tracking, ceramic models and battery life updates.
